claim: Bray Cottages comprises 7 properties with capacities from 2 to 6 guests across Yew Tree, Christmas, Dormer, Tiggers, Lavender House and Bray House.

claim: Booking a room at The Waterside Inn guarantees guests a table for dinner at the 3-star restaurant.
quote: we booked ourselves a Friday night stay at The Waterside Inn, a 3-Michelin starred restaurant in Bray. It has hotel rooms upstairs, and reserving accommodation here guarantees guests a table for dinner.

claim: The Waterside Inn has 11 individually designed guest rooms across Classic, Superior, Deluxe and Suite categories, located in the main building or adjacent cottages.
quote: 11 individually designed guest rooms across four categories: Classic Rooms, Superior Rooms, Deluxe Rooms, Suites ... in the main building, or one of our cosy cottages next to the main restaurant.

claim: Monkey Island Estate is footbridge-only access on a private Thames island, within walking distance of Bray's restaurants; a small luxury hotel with bar and brasserie suited to dining-centred short stays. Maidenhead is ~25 min by Elizabeth line from London.
quote: footbridge-only access ... adds a sense of arrival ... within walking distance of Bray's iconic restaurants ... ideal for brief stays centered around dining experiences.

claim: Monkey Island Estate room rates start from approximately £275 per night for a Temple Room.
quote: room rates typically start from around £275 per night for a Temple Room.

claim: Bray's village conservation area can be walked around in about an hour and contains The Fat Duck, Waterside Inn, Hind's Head and other notable dining.
quote: Bray is small, and it's easy to walk around the conservation area in the heart of town in an hour or so.

claim: Hind's Head is a one-Michelin-starred pub at High Street, Bray, SL6 2AB.
quote: Hinds Head – Bray, High Street, Bray, SL6 2AB. One MICHELIN Star.

claim: Waterside Inn is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant at Ferry Road, Bray, SL6 2AT; tables sell out weeks ahead.

claim: Bray Cottages are described as opposite the Waterside Inn's front door and a short walk to the other Bray eateries.
